candidates.description: This feature vector activates on tokens containing the letter 'h' or common phonetic variations and abbreviations associated with it.
These tokens represent verb suffixes and inflectional endings commonly found in past tense or participial forms.
This vector represents common English inflectional suffixes and morphological endings used for verbs, nouns, and adjectives.
This vector represents proper nouns, particularly names of people, places, and religious affiliations, heavily weighted toward English-language contexts.
This vector detects common phonetic syllables and short morphological suffixes across various languages.
This vector represents linguistic and geographic terms, specifically focusing on British and Irish placenames, demonyms, and related suffixes.
This feature vector fires on words, name components, and phonetic fragments ending with the "-all" or "-al" sound across multiple scripts and languages.
This feature activates on common linguistic suffixes and word-ending character n-grams across multiple languages.
This vector represents the Hindi script (Devanagari characters and words) mixed with noisy multilingual text fragments.
This feature vector represents linguistic suffixes and morphological endings across various languages.
